_seat_read: Engine.seat_of: the weapon's primary seat (role_menu[0]) — the one role read; a menu-less weapon counts toward no seat

_split.rule: battle % 5 != 0 (training split; % 5 == 0 is the v4h holdout)

_typical: seats: round-half-up(p50) where p50 >= 1; copies: free = round-half-up(p50) (>= 1), max = ceil(p90) (>= free); a weapon under the floor has no row
_unit: one DISTINCT fully-known killer roster (guild set + weapon multiset) of 10+, one vote; pooled = every winner at the size, styles = the party_styles.json label; seat cells per exact size pool a +-1 then +-2 window until >= _min_distinct rosters (`window`); copy and distinct cells per band
